elements.label: About
elements.value: Controls how fast the camera responds to stick/mouse input and how smoothly it tracks.

onChange.template:
[Gameplan: update .gameplan/camera/properties/sensitivity_smoothing.schema.json, set ss_c_feel to {{ss_c_feel}}]
Apply {{ss_c_feel}} camera feel preset. Adjusts rotationSpeed and translationSpeed on ThirdPersonCamera.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/camera/properties/sensitivity_smoothing.schema.json, set ss_t_sensitivity to {{ss_t_sensitivity}}]
Set ThirdPersonCamera.mouseSensitivity to {{ss_t_sensitivity}}.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/camera/properties/sensitivity_smoothing.schema.json, set ss_t_rot_speed to {{ss_t_rot_speed}}]
Set ThirdPersonCamera.rotationSpeed to {{ss_t_rot_speed}}.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/camera/properties/sensitivity_smoothing.schema.json, set ss_t_trans_speed to {{ss_t_trans_speed}}]
Set ThirdPersonCamera.translationSpeed to {{ss_t_trans_speed}}.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/camera/properties/sensitivity_smoothing.schema.json, set ss_t_default_pitch to {{ss_t_default_pitch}}]
Set ThirdPersonCamera.defaultPitch to {{ss_t_default_pitch}} degrees. Negative = looking slightly downward.
